name: Talking About Travel Plans
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on talking about travel plans — practice these key phrases out loud:
We're planning a trip to the coast next month.
I can't wait to try the local food there.
How long is the flight from here?
Have you ever been backpacking before?
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
